summary: Ansible 14 netapp.ontap changes: an updated ONTAP personality check, REST-only na_ontap_autoupdate_config and na_ontap_cg (ONTAP 9.10.1+), and AWS Lambda support in many modules including na_ontap_cifs*, cluster_peer, dns, export_policy(_rule), flexcache, igroup, interface and iscsi.
questions: Which netapp.ontap modules support AWS Lambda?
What ONTAP version does na_ontap_cg need?
